title: PR #197: fix(pr187): enforce registry accounting and isolate consensus E2E
content:
State: open
Merged: False
Draft: True

## Scope

Stacked on PR #187 at `e29b21da9d5e7429b24023796ec03c29e09d98a9`.

- Replace the tautological registry accounting check with an independent comparison between actual registry entries per repository and the declared `RUNTIME_SYMBOL` classification count.
- Add a regression test proving that removing a runtime entry while leaving the summary unchanged fails validation.
- Replace fixed RPC/P2P test ports with ephemeral local ports in the persistent two-node consensus E2E test.
- Detect child-process exit while waiting for status and use RAII cleanup so spawned nodes are killed/reaped if assertions panic.

## Explicitly unresolved

The canonical registry reconciliation is **not included**: the exact census and rebuilt-registry artifacts are available, but the 70-entry discrepancy has not yet been reconciled against the checked-in canonical JSON entry by entry. Validator strictness remains enabled; no summary totals were hand-edited.

## Verification status

Draft / NOT VERIFIED pending CI. No merge is authorized by this PR.
